prompt_intro:
The crate does not build against the vendored `client` 2.0.0. The
constructor `Client::new(host, port)` was removed; version 2 provides
`client::builder().host(..).port(..).build()`, which fails with
`BuildError::EmptyHost` for an empty host. Do not modify `dep/`. Keep
`pub fn connect(host: &str, port: u16, path: &str) -> Result<String, String>`
and return the error string `empty host` when the host is empty.
